module_summary: 4-entry by 4-bit LIFO stack: a stack pointer indexes a small memory, RW selects push or pop when enabled, and FULL/EMPTY flags derived from the pointer gate operations.

anchors.name: stack_mem
anchors.why: 4x4-bit stack array written on push, read and cleared on pop.

anchors.name: SP
anchors.why: Stack pointer indexing stack_mem; decrements on push, increments on pop, sets FULL/EMPTY.

anchors.name: RW
anchors.why: Selects push (0) or pop (1) operation on the stack.

anchors.name: dataIn
anchors.why: Data pushed into stack_mem at SP.

anchors.name: dataOut
anchors.why: Registered popped value read from stack_mem at SP.

anchors.name: EN
anchors.why: Global operation enable; gates reset, push and pop.

anchors.name: FULL
anchors.why: Full flag from SP; blocks pushes and reported as output.

anchors.name: EMPTY
anchors.why: Empty flag from SP[2]; blocks pops and reported as output.

groups.name: stack_control
groups.description: Stack pointer update and full/empty flag generation under RW and EN.

groups.name: stack_memory
groups.description: Stack array with push data input and registered pop output.
